idea-plugin.name: SolKey
idea-plugin.description:
Prove a Solidity contract or function with KeY.

Click the ▶ beside a public or external function in a .sol file to open KeYther, the SolKey prover GUI, on that function's proof obligation — no function picker in between. If KeYther cannot generate an obligation, it reports the reason, such as an unnamed return value or a parameter with no .key sort. The ▶ beside a contract covers every function it declares.

Right-click a ▶ for the headless prover, which reports N/M closed and the remaining sequents in a console. Contracts and functions without parameters also offer Compile and Run (solc + EVM), which reports any failing assert.

A .key file gets a ▶ beside its \problem: click it to open the problem in KeYther, or right-click it for the headless prover.

No Solidity language plugin is required: the declarations are found by scanning the file.

.key and .proof files are syntax highlighted with the prover's own ANTLR lexer, so taclet keywords, variable conditions and the Solidity inside a modality are coloured exactly as the prover reads them.

action.description: Open KeYther on the Solidity function or contract at the caret
